h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bhiwani

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bhiwani

items.pText: Bhiwani in Haryana has a strong sporting reputation, especially in boxing, and many families here want children to be active from an early age. Schools, sports academies and residential colonies in Bhiwani are our likely buyers. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 1,100 km away, and sends it by road for installation by our team or a dealer serving Haryana.

For children who are already active, a slide and a swing are not enough for long. Older children aged 6 to 12 want to climb, balance, hang and test their strength. Climbing frames, nets, balance beams and rope structures give them that challenge on a school ground. Galvanised steel frames and play rope hold up to the dry heat of a Haryana summer and the cold winter mornings. Both carry a 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects.

items.q: What playground equipment suits older, active children?
items.a: Climbers, net structures, balancing beams and rope bridges. They let children aged 6 to 12 climb, balance and build strength. Plan a wide safe play area with rubber flooring underneath.

items.q: Can a sports academy add play equipment for younger siblings?
items.a: Yes. A small corner with spring riders and a short slide keeps younger children busy while older ones train. We show both areas on one layout drawing.

items.q: Do you install playground equipment in Bhiwani?
items.a: Yes. We send equipment from our Vasai factory by road and install it in Bhiwani with our team or a dealer, grouted or self-standing.
